description: Property identifier. If the input file had an `aoi_id` column it is preserved; otherwise generated from row index (0-indexed).
Area of the building, in square feet.

JSON list of all roofs linked to this building, sorted by IoU (Intersection over Union) descending. Each item: `{feature_id, iou}`.
The unique ID for the class of this feature.
Area of the building clipped to the parcel boundary, in square feet.
Confidence in detection of the building (single feature, not combined).
A description of the class of this feature.
Feature ID of the building.
Quality of the shape of the vectorized footprint polygon (and implicitly the accuracy of the area measurement).

Boolean indicator of whether 3D attribute data from Nearmap is available for this record.
The height of the building in feet.  Only available for `Building 3d attributes` class, omitted if not available.
Whether this feature is the parcel's primary feature for its class — selected by the largest-intersection strategy (see README → Primary Feature Selection).
URL to view this row in Nearmap MapBrowser. Per-class files (roof, building, etc.) frame the URL on each feature's centroid; the rollup frames it on the parcel.

Date of the 3D mesh used for 3D attributes (height, pitch, etc.). The mesh is usually comprised of a number of overlapping surveys captured at a similar time of year, so this date represents that capture window rather than a single survey.

Confidence in num storeys 1 classification on this building. When multiple detections contribute: top-level feature classes on the parcel (e.g. all roofs, all vegetation segments) are combined so confidence rises with corroborating detections; sub-attributes within a parent feature (e.g. staining on a roof) take the maximum across detections. Null when the corresponding area is 0.
